params={"query.intr":"sotorasib OR adagrasib OR divarasib OR glecirasib OR olomorasib OR opnurasib OR fulzerasib OR garsorasib OR \"KRAS G12C inhibitor\"",
        "filter.overallStatus":"RECRUITING,NOT_YET_RECRUITING",
        "countTotal":"true","pageSize":"200",
        "fields":"NCTId,BriefTitle,OverallStatus,Phases,InterventionName,LeadSponsorName,Condition,StartDate"}
r=requests.get(base,params=params,timeout=60)
print(r.status_code)
d=r.json()
print("TOTAL",d.get("totalCount"), "returned", len(d.get("studies",[])))

input.command:
def rec(s):
    p=s["protocolSection"]
    i=p["identificationModule"]; st=p["statusModule"]; dm=p.get("designModule",{})
    ai=p.get("armsInterventionsModule",{}); sp=p.get("sponsorCollaboratorsModule",{})
    ints=[x.get("name","") for x in ai.get("interventions",[])]
    return dict(nct=i["nctId"], title=i["briefTitle"][:95],
                status=st["overallStatus"], start=st.get("startDateStruct",{}).get("date",""),
                phase="/".join(dm.get("phases",[])) or "NA",
                sponsor=sp.get("leadSponsor",{}).get("name","")[:38],
                cond="; ".join(p.get("conditionsModule",{}).get("conditions",[]))[:45],
                ints="; ".join(ints)[:110])
rows=[rec(s) for s in d["studies"]]
drugs=["sotorasib","lumakras","amg 510","amg510","adagrasib","krazati","mrtx849","divarasib","gdc-6036",
 "glecirasib","jab-21822","goleirex","olomorasib","ly3537982","opnurasib","jdq443","fulzerasib","gfh925","ibi351",
 "garsorasib","d-1553","mk-1084","bpi-421286","jnj-74699157","ly3499446","g12c"]
def isg12c(row):
    t=(row["ints"]+" "+row["title"]).lower()
    return any(dr in t for dr in drugs)
hit=[x for x in rows if isg12c(x)]
print(len(rows),"->",len(hit))
from collections import Counter
print(Counter(x["phase"] for x in hit))
print(Counter(x["status"] for x in hit))
for x in sorted(hit,key=lambda z:(z["phase"],z["nct"])):
    print(f'{x["nct"]} | {x["phase"]:<13} | {x["status"]:<16} | {x["start"]:<10} | {x["sponsor"]}')
    print(f'    {x["title"]}')
    print(f'    cond: {x["cond"]} || intr: {x["ints"]}')
